free_tier.stated: Free tier reported at 10,000 API calls and 1,000 NZB downloads per user per day, with a USD 20 lifetime VIP; caps declares <registration available="yes" open="yes"/> and <limits max="100" default="100"/>.
free_tier.notes: The 10,000 figure appears in two independent third-party sources but neither is dated on the page, so it is kept as reported and flagged as the number to check first with an account.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: Free tier 2,700 days across 500+ indexed newsgroups; VIP 3,900 days (nzbhydra.com, 2026-10-23).
retention.notes: reported; a second third-party review states 'Retention is currently at five years and still growing', which differs from the figure in the retention field

egress.terms: No byte metering; the API returns pointers.

interface_detail: Newznab API at /api. /api with no parameters returns <error code="200" description="Missing parameter"/>, which is the Newznab key check, so the endpoint is live and keyed.
tooling: Native Newznab, listed as integrating with NZBVortex and SabNZBD, so Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 add it with URL plus key.
chaining: The only open-registration indexer claiming a five-figure daily API allowance, which is what an arr stack actually needs; the caveat is that the claim is third-party and undated.
limits_note: At 10,000 calls a day the request rate stops being the constraint and the 100-result page becomes it: a client that wants a whole season must paginate.
binding_note: If the reported allowance holds, nothing in the vocabulary binds at 1 TiB/month; the record still names request-rate because that is the only counter the vendor is documented to run, and it is the one to verify first.

identity_cost.detail: The register form asks for username, email, password and a Google reCAPTCHA; its invitecode input is type="hidden", so no invite code is asked in the form. The API documents a register function that 'Does not require any credentials'. Whether the server enforces an invite was not tested: submitting the form creates an account.

reliability_note: The public pages of the domain now sell Usenet block accounts and advertise 'Pay Only ONCE', so the indexer and a news provider share one brand; a report of a database outage and fake releases in September 2026 exists in a third-party status tracker.
confidence_note: caps, the keyed error and the registration form were observed today; the allowance that decides the verdict is third-party. One free account moves this to documented.
